<function name="GetFOV" parent="NextBot" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the Field of View of the Nextbot NPC, used for its vision functionality, such as <page>NextBot:IsAbleToSee</page>.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<added>2020.08.12</added>
	<rets>
		<ret name="fov" type="number">The current FOV of the nextbot</ret>
	</rets>
	
</function>
